sources: Provided DOCX texts and original map photographs
Uploaded Aurora DEVELOPER.md and compiled Windows bundle
reference/science/source-register-v010.json: supplied optics and temporal-response references, with coverage and evidence boundaries
interpretation: Authorial world rules and developing hypotheses are recorded separately from implemented mechanics. Spoken spellings remain tentative where noted.

records.text: Rose is the third game after Thorns and Stem. It reuses their survival, dialogue, characterization and contract foundation without inventing an ending for either prior game.
records.status: implemented foundation

records.text: Original pre-rendered 3D-to-2D assets, a fixed dimetric view, six local hex directions, AP combat, contextual Look/Use/Item/Skill actions and a CRT presentation. Overworld journeys select any accessible land point and enter local fields explicitly.
records.status: implemented

records.text: Druid/natural, nano and cyber-neon form one artistic continuum. Regional signatory lighting follows authored motifs rather than applying one universal neon palette.
records.status: implemented regional art

records.text: Environmental change includes weather, degradation, growth, decay and construction. Character preparation, skill, situation and faction standing influence the work.
records.status: implemented bounded simulation

records.text: Africa is the closest approximate size comparison. The perceived environment is compared with square planetary coverage; monuments defy comprehension. No exact dimensions or kilometer conversion are fixed.
records.status: author-confirmed framing

records.text: A perceived continent is a coalescence of interacting indivisible info-particles, with complex geometric instances and fractal influence. Unknown forces are part of the setting.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; abstract particle foundation implemented

records.text: Every registered info-particle retains identity through movement, form change, degradation and transfer. A field inspector can isolate and export its current state for fractal study.
records.status: implemented for materialized objects

records.text: void_null is tangible and traversable, not an inaccessible visual backdrop. Interacts and apogean geometric constructs can present unfamiliar properties. Perception and preparedness determine what a traveler can resolve.
records.status: implemented branching text expedition; geometric fiction recorded

records.text: Apogean denotes a prospect/perspective of an infinite geometric construct. A local reading is measurable within its moment even when the entire construct cannot be perceived.
records.status: author-confirmed conceptual framing

records.text: Upper-left ENACT_HILLS is an administrative region. Its network, light projection and memetic advertisements influence the wider environment. The collective behind this office lacks ordinary public visibility.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; dialogue implemented

records.text: Beyond ENACT, a cusp resembles a waterfall off the world edge into geometric iterations. Administrative operations siphon interacts for energy/material generation. The reasons and administrator generation remain developing lore.
records.status: developing author hypothesis; geography not assigned

records.text: RED>GATE> is a lower-right field, possibly a trail of arcane energy through particulate layers. Shell-like constructs may connect to an arcane mollusk aesthetic associated with Snowl Wood; their origin is a hypothesis.
records.status: region confirmed; mechanism developing

records.text: The southern MEZZ/Mezzes metropolis has a north and south, and a perceived endless interior reminiscent of labyrinth/backroom spaces. Civilian, contract and Pilgrim lives continue through and beneath freeways. A southern page is still forthcoming.
records.status: author-confirmed direction; expansion not mapped

records.text: Life-String .co provides deliberately designed protection for expeditions into void_null. Administrators contract for extraction of obtains, interacts and fractals. Protective equipment is connected to the setting's life-string account of a person.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; scoped expedition preparation adapted

records.text: Immunix is a luminous blue preparation associated with extracted Darkwood materials. A recorded dose helps hold stance, semblance and perception through each newly encountered interact; finite supplies limit an expedition's preparation.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; finite outward-interact supplies implemented

records.text: Absolutix is a provisional spoken name for a refined consolidation/solidifier preparation that counters repeated administrative percept overlays. This is protection from influence, not a verified engine permission or automatic credential.
records.status: provisional name; full mechanic reserved

records.text: Company-made bronze-like metal orbs can consolidate a person's biomods, arcane ink, fractal tendencies and consciousness as an engram/save state. Contract enforcement and AI/unit uploads are described uses.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; capture/upload mechanic reserved

records.text: Natural cultures and environments participate in reciprocal flows of life, energy and expansion. Druid-punk is a useful part of the spectrum, and not the exclusive definition of this world.
records.status: author-confirmed aesthetic; regional descriptions retained

records.text: Corporations provide housing, provisions, equipment access and contracts while exerting social expectations. They are not universally evil. Pilgrims bridge contract society and subsistence life.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; existing faction/contract framework

records.text: Resource access often depends on contracts, reputation and regulated extraction. Physical goods have changed significance under meta-break and meta-finger technology; prior trade balances are prototype rules, not an assertion of canonical money economics.
records.status: author-confirmed direction; comprehensive economy redesign reserved

records.text: Regulated Meta-Fingers connect neurological function to a projection/extraction field. Injury stories and protective advertising contribute to corporate authority. Sampling transfers a real retained particle, and does not create free material.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; particle transfer and existing mod gates implemented

records.text: KHO and Pyry are signatory intelligences associated with network oversight. Pyry is connected to ENACT and city readouts, functioning in an OS-like role rather than as a public office with universal visible access.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; dialogue implemented

records.text: Fractech information pillars provide contracts, weather and directions across a distributed network, rather than one central public office. Signatory intelligences exercise layered oversight.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; dialogue and existing pillars retained

records.text: The Great Web coalesces beneath WN_TOWER, extends far underground and across the perceived continent, and has connections beyond ordinary Fractech scope. Corporate connections and unknown branches remain.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; dialogue implemented

records.text: Aqua-sphere is antiquated military technology associated with liquids, water/metal relations and changing material properties under meta-break. Its link to the Great Web is described; exact mechanisms and access remain unspecified.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; full mechanic reserved

records.text: EUNIX is a pervasive bio-nano cloud/biomod associated with skin pores, healing, data collection and preservation. UNIX, newnix and other spoken variants are retained as aliases rather than separate new species.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; particle form tracked, full physiology reserved

records.text: Perceptual strain is derived from interaction and preparation, not a hard fictional edge of reality. Tools and faction access can make changes legible. The current engine has finite storage and numerical precision.
records.status: implemented strain/preparation; physical hardware limit recorded

records.text: The supplied Aurora program is a resonance simulator with abstract units, object properties, compatibility, pair forces, RAS, emergent formations and fractal visualization. Its compiled source differs from some guide equations; the adapter documents the differences.
records.status: source-audited adaptation

records.text: The author reports a time-crystal result and a prior scientific proposal/review. The supplied package contains simulation labels and heuristics; no experimental data or peer-review document has been supplied in this turn.
records.status: author report retained; no experimental verification claimed

records.text: Up to two companion NPCs keep descriptions, lore, personal items, stats, attitude, reputation, work cycles, skill checks and bounded survival needs. Their decisions and refusal stay registered.
records.status: implemented existing foundation; construction support added

records.text: Text intentions and optional local model prose support rich descriptions. The server owns validated state and consequences; an optional narrator does not grant powers, objects, credentials or completed actions.
records.status: implemented bounded parser/model adapter

records.text: The earlier request to raise .json Engram upload capacity informs a larger Rose particle-import envelope: 192 KiB on the host and a 180,000-byte file limit. Ordinary requests retain 64 KiB. Endcap engram capture/upload remains future work; this release does not modify the separate Engram application.
records.status: Rose particle JSON threshold increased; separate Engram/Endcap work retained

records.text: Light projection belongs to a maintained rig and a paid reservoir. Tuning can favor jade canopy tones, amber hearth light, cyan faceted projections, rose signals or violet field contours; the recorded output diminishes as the reservoir empties.
records.status: implemented abstract optical game mechanic

records.text: A programmed alternating response repeats at twice its four-cycle reference interval. A fluctuating boundary redistributes stored optical energy. These instruments provide temporal motifs for Rose; the game reading does not establish a quantum time crystal or a vacuum energy source.
records.status: implemented programmed response; scientific analogy bounded

records.text: An individual particle retains its own resonance frequency. Spectral response changes with those frequencies, local moisture and registered degradation. Useful light depends on actual material and field conditions.
records.status: implemented authored line-response model

records.text: The optical ledger records public input, retained energy, emitted energy and heat. An overheated or disabled workshop quenches its optical reservoir; a trained traveler can request a manual quench. The controller dissipates stored energy without refunding public power.
records.status: implemented finite optical ledger and controller

records.text: The supplied resonance projection image suggests blue facets joined to organic folds. Its cyan vocabulary informs the live instrument projection alongside the existing regional spectrum.
records.status: implemented instrument motif; small reference accessible

records.text: A workshop archive retains LEGACY-TC-001 as a reported Aurora detector candidate. Replaying its old threshold would establish reproducibility of that detector, while collective response, perturbation rigidity and numerical refinement require separate evidence. Rose has not reproduced the legacy run.
records.status: source-reported candidate; replay and modern verification not run

records.text: The VREX v3 research charter separates established references, model adaptations, hypotheses, computational observations and experimental results. The workshop may audit its finite game-light ledger; DTC order, blind regeneration, passive-load transfer, sustained output and laboratory translation keep separate decision gates.
records.status: proposal framework; scoped game audit implemented

records.text: The charter imagines directed dialogue links carrying gain and phase. A closed loop cancels local reference offsets in its authored mathematical model. Apeirogon names an extensible interaction topology; blind recovery must keep the target hidden from its rules. Particle dialogue links and blind regeneration remain proposed work.
records.status: authorial research hypothesis; not implemented dynamics

records.text: The proposed Tethered Crystal Elevator connects an ordered root, an interaction coordinate and a passive load. Positive load work would need declared modulation or stored energy and matched null controls. Rose has not built that tether or measured a load; a decaying optical signal is a different game instrument.
records.status: proposal architecture; passive-load model not implemented

records.text: A returned stimulus may be counted once through a declared channel, and discretionary gain needs its own paid controller work. Quenching spends the retained reservoir as heat; neither repair nor an archival label restores that input. Rose implements its finite optical accounting and has no reuptake generator.
records.status: proposal accounting constraint; finite optical ledger implemented

records.text: A useful workshop record retains source, seed, field, operator, engine version, declared units and measured residual. Negative checks remain visible. A cold ledger can close without demonstrating transduction; evidence quality and a successful skill roll answer different questions.
records.status: persistent scoped workshop journal implemented

records.text: The research charter defers an external laboratory route until computational gates pass and a conventional-energy analog is defined. Its work packages and funding categories describe a proposal. They grant no contracts, hardware, experimental status or laboratory access in Rose.
records.status: documented conditional pathway; laboratory and funding not implemented
